summary: Diageo plc filed a Form 6-K to announce a notification of its full-year fiscal 2026 preliminary results and a Capital Markets Day scheduled for August 6, 2026. The filing is a routine regulatory notification providing details on the timing of the results release and the investor event, including webcast and contact information. There are no transactions, price terms, premiums, advisors, or structural mechanics associated with a special situation. This is an ordinary disclosure by a foreign private issuer of a future corporate announcement.
